features.intro: Turn features on or off in YouTube Settings under FaroTV Patches, using switches that match the app.

feature.ads.body: Removes video ads and sponsored videos from Home.
feature.sponsor.body: Automatically skips sponsorships, self-promotion and subscription reminders marked by the community. Intros, credits and filler are optional.
feature.dislikes.body: Return YouTube Dislike shows the count when you focus the Dislike button.
feature.shorts.body: Hide Shorts, topic tabs and YouTube Premium promotions.
feature.player.body: Choose which buttons to hide: Channel, Description, Subscribe, Comments, Ask (AI) and more, plus related videos.
feature.brand.body: Your own name, icon, banner, launch screen and amber accent instead of YouTube red.
feature.microg.body: If MicroG-RE is missing, FaroTV offers to download and install it from GitHub, then restart.
feature.memory.body: Does not start automatically when the TV turns on and keeps a connection to MicroG-RE while open. Tested on a TV with 1 GB of RAM.
feature.spoof.body: For TVs YouTube marks as unsupported: identifies the TV as a Chromecast.

step.source.title: Add the source
step.patch.title: Patch your APK
step.open.title: Install and open FaroTV
step.source.add: Select Add to Morphe, or add this source in Morphe Manager:
step.patch.apk: Choose your YouTube for Android TV 7.32.300 or 8.02.300 APK. Recommended patches are selected by default.
step.patch.spoof: Enable Spoof device only if YouTube says your TV is unsupported.
step.open.install: Install the patched APK on your TV. If MicroG-RE is missing, FaroTV offers to download and install it there.
step.open.login: Sign in with your phone or at yt.be/activate.
install.settings: Find the switches in Settings → FaroTV Patches. Options that need it display a restart prompt.
